arxiv-2104-12175.title: Seeking Quality Diversity in Evolutionary Co-design of Morphology and Control of Soft Tensegrity Modular Robots Conference: 2021 Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference; July 10–14, 2021; Lille, France 2021 Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference (GECCO ’21), July 10–14, 2021, Lille,
arxiv-2104-12175.creator: Enrico Zardini, Davide Zappetti, Davide Zambrano, Giovanni Iacca, Dario Floreano
arxiv-2104-12175.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Enrico Zardini, Davide Zappetti, Davide Zambrano, Giovanni Iacca, Dario Floreano. Designing optimal soft modular robots is difficult, due to non-trivial interactions between morphology and controller. Evolutionary algorithms (EAs), combined with physical simulators, represent a valid tool to overcome this issue. In this work, we investigate algorithmic solutions to improve the Quality Diversity of co-evolved designs of Tensegrity Soft Modular Robots (TSMRs) for two robotic tasks, namely goal reaching and squeezing trough a narrow passage.

arxiv-2202-06870.title: AnoMili: Spoofing Prevention and Explainable Anomaly Detection for the 1553 Military Avionic Bus
arxiv-2202-06870.creator: Efrat Levy, Nadav Maman, Asaf Shabtai, Yuval Elovici
arxiv-2202-06870.description: Abstract MIL-STD-1553, a standard that defines a communication bus for interconnected devices, is widely used in military and aerospace avionic platforms. Due to its lack of security mechanisms, MIL-STD-1553 is exposed to cyber threats. The methods previously proposed to address these threats are very limited, resulting in the need for more advanced techniques.

arxiv-2203-06088.title: Game Dynamics Structure Controlled by Design: an Example from Experimental Economics
arxiv-2203-06088.creator: Wang Zhijian
arxiv-2203-06088.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Wang Zhijian. Game dynamics structure (e.g., endogenous cycle motion) in human subjects game experiments can be predicted by game dynamics theory. However, whether the structure can be controlled by mechanism design to a desired goal is not known.

arxiv-2211-07451.title: Additive Covariance Matrix Models: Modelling Regional Electricity Net-Demand in Great Britain
arxiv-2211-07451.creator: V. Gioia, M. Fasiolo, J. Browell, R. Bellio
arxiv-2211-07451.description: Abstract Forecasts of regional electricity net-demand, consumption minus embedded generation, are an essential input for reliable and economic power system operation, and energy trading. While such forecasts are typically performed region by region, operations such as managing power flows require spatially coherent joint forecasts, which account for cross-regional dependencies.

arxiv-2302-14779.title: Twisted Drinfeld Centers and Framed String-Nets
arxiv-2302-14779.creator: Hannes Knötzele, Christoph Schweigert, Matthias Traube
arxiv-2302-14779.description: Abstract . We discuss a string-net construction on 2 2 -framed surfaces, taking as algebraic input a finite, rigid tensor category, which is neither assumed to be pivotal nor semi-simple. It is shown that circle categories of our framed string-net construction essentially compute Drinfeld centers twisted by powers of the double dual functor. ZMP-HH/23-2 Hamburger Beiträge zur Mathematik Nr.

arxiv-2304-09678.title: Column Subset Selection and Nyström Approximation via Continuous Optimization
arxiv-2304-09678.creator: Anant Mathur, Sarat Moka, Zdravko Botev
arxiv-2304-09678.description: Abstract We propose a continuous optimization algorithm for the Column Subset Selection Problem (CSSP) and Nyström approximation. The CSSP and Nyström method construct low-rank approximations of matrices based on a predetermined subset of columns. It is well known that choosing the best column subset of size k k is a difficult combinatorial problem.

arxiv-2311-07003.title: Shot noise-mitigated secondary electron imaging with ion count-aided microscopy
arxiv-2311-07003.creator: Akshay Agarwal, Leila Kasaei, Xinglin He, Ruangrawee Kitichotkul, Oğuz Kağan Hitit, Minxu Peng, J. Albert Schultz, Leonard C. Feldman, Vivek K Goyal
arxiv-2311-07003.description: Abstract Modern science is dependent on imaging on the nanoscale, often achieved through processes that detect secondary electrons created by a highly focused incident charged particle beam. Multiple types of measurement noise limit the ultimate trade-off between the image quality and the incident particle dose, which can preclude useful imaging of dose-sensitive samples.

arxiv-2412-13950.title: Generation of Large District Heating System Models Using Open-Source Data and Tools: An Exemplary Workflow Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2412-13950.creator: Jan Stock, Till Schmidt, André Xhonneux, Dirk Müller
arxiv-2412-13950.description: Abstract 1 Introduction District heating (DH) systems are a key technology for decarbonising the heat supply in the building sector. While new concepts such as low-exergy DH and cooling systems are being developed and established in newly built housing areas, existing DH systems must be transformed into a sustainable heat supply since most systems still rely on fossil-based heating plants.

pmc-10582635.title: Back to basics: likelihood ratios for olive and grass pollen specific IgE in seasonal allergic rhinitis
pmc-10582635.creator: Bárbara Manzanares, Rafael González, Pilar Serrano, Ana Navas, Corona Alonso, Lourdes Fernandez, Aurora Jurado, Carmen Moreno-Aguilar
pmc-10582635.description: IntroductionSpecific IgE (sIgE) is merely a sensitization marker that cannot be used for allergy diagnosis if there are no associated clinical symptoms. As of 2023, there is still no evidence regarding the quantity of sIgE necessary to confirm or exclude clinical disease.

pmc-11380029.title: A new route to the synthesis of 2-hydrazolyl-4-thiazolidinone hybrids, evaluation of α-glucosidase inhibitory activity and molecular modeling insights
pmc-11380029.creator: Saghi Sepehri, Ghazaleh Farhadi, Maryam Maghbul, Farough Nasiri, Mohammad Ali Faramarzi, Karim Mahnam, Somayeh Mojtabavi, Mohammad Mahdavi, Zhaleh Moharrami Oranj
pmc-11380029.description: One of the multifactorial worldwide health syndromes is diabetes mellitus which is increasing at a disturbing rate. The inhibition of α-glucosidase, an enzyme that catalyzes starch hydrolysis in the intestine, is one helpful therapeutic approach for controlling hyperglycemia related to type-2 diabetes. To discover α-glucosidase inhibitors, some 2-hydrazolyl-4-thiazolidinone hybrids (3a-e) were synthesized from new one-pot reaction procedures.

pmc-11628882.title: Exploring the role of FAT genes in Solanaceae species through genome‐wide analysis and genome editing
pmc-11628882.creator: Sibel Bahadır, Mohamed Farah Abdulla, Karam Mostafa, Musa Kavas, Safa Hacıkamiloğlu, Orhan Kurt, Kubilay Yıldırım
pmc-11628882.description: Plants produce numerous fatty acid derivatives, and some of these compounds have significant regulatory functions, such as governing effector‐induced resistance, systemic resistance, and other defense pathways. This study systematically identified and characterized eight FAT genes (Acyl‐acyl carrier protein thioesterases), four in the Solanum lycopersicum and four in the Solanum tuberosum genome.

pmc-12361399.description: High-mass-loading cathodes are crucial for achieving high energy density in all-solid-state batteries from the lab scale to industry. However, as mass-loading increases, electrochemical performance is significantly compromised due to sluggish kinetics. In this work, operando neutron imaging is deployed on a high-mass-loading NMC 811 cathode of 33 mg/cm2 (5.

pmc-12417768.title: Influence of a defoaming agent – simethicone – on endoscope cleaning and disinfection: Prospective real-world study
pmc-12417768.creator: Juanjuan Huang, Tingsheng Ling, Junlin Zhang, Lianzhen Wei, Lei Chen, Huiwen Cao, Lei Wang, Yitong Liu, Dongkun Wen, Danrui Ren, Yang Li
pmc-12417768.description: Background and study aimsSimethicone has been extensively utilized in endoscopy examinations and therapies; however, consensus regarding its impact on endoscopy cleaning is still lacking. The aim of this study was to assess impact of simethicone use during endoscopic examination on efficacy of endoscope cleaning.

pmc-12557491.title: Spatializing Ames: Complementing the Ames, IA housing dataset for spatial social-ecological analysis
pmc-12557491.creator: David Barbour, Michail Fragkias
pmc-12557491.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This paper introduces a spatially-explicit dataset as a complement to a well-known economics and data science dataset - the Ames, Iowa housing dataset. We combine geospatial land cover data with the locations of houses sold between 2006–2010, allowing researchers to explore questions such as the impact of surrounding land cover on property values or the valuation of ecosystem services that result from different types of land cover.

pmc-12564699.title: Genome-Wide Identification and Biotic Stress Responses of TLP Gene Family in Citrus sinensis
pmc-12564699.creator: Xingtao Li, Lizhen Fan, Chang Liu, Xinrui Wang, Xiaoyuan Zhang, Xiaonan Tong, Andrei Smertenko
pmc-12564699.description: Thaumatin-like proteins (TLPs), a subfamily of pathogenesis-related (PR) proteins, play a vital role in plant defense against pathogens. In this study, 23 CsTLP genes were identified in the Citrus sinensis genome. These genes encode proteins ranging from 203 to 512 amino acids, with molecular weights between 21.88 and 53.75 kDa, classifying them as small molecular weight proteins.

pmc-13332817.title: Nonsurgical Endodontic Management of Type II Dens Invaginatus Associated with Gemination in a Maxillary Lateral Incisor: A CBCT-Assisted Case Report
pmc-13332817.creator: Maryam Dalaei Moghadam
pmc-13332817.description: Dens invaginatus (DI) is a developmental dental anomaly characterized by the invagination of the enamel organ into the dental papilla during tooth development, often resulting in complex root canal anatomy and increased susceptibility to pulpal disease. Gemination is another uncommon developmental anomaly resulting from the incomplete division of a single tooth germ, which produces an enlarged or bifid crown.

pmc-13342696.title: Concurrent Brucellosis and Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia: A Case Report
pmc-13342696.creator: Parisa Bahramian, Marziyeh Ghalamkari, Mahdi Khatuni, Saeed Kalantari, Behnaz Varaminian
pmc-13342696.description: IntroductionAcute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) is a rare hematologic malignancy that leads to significant qualitative and quantitative lymphocyte deficits. These immunological gaps predispose patients to various bacterial and opportunistic infections. Brucellosis, an intracellular infection endemic in many regions including Iran, presents with nonspecific symptoms such as prolonged fever, malaise, and organomegaly, which closely mimic the clinical manifestations of leukemia.

pmc-13612751.title: Disseminated Pulmonary and Hepatic Cystic Echinococcosis Presenting as Suspected Pulmonary Embolism and Mimicking Metastatic Malignancy
pmc-13612751.creator: Samarth E Joseph, Khansa S Makawi, Prakash Joseph, Hissa N Alsuwaidi
pmc-13612751.description: Cystic echinococcosis (CE) is a chronic zoonotic infection caused by Echinococcus granulosus that most commonly affects the liver and lungs. In disseminated disease, the combination of bilateral pulmonary nodules, cavitary consolidation, mediastinal lymphadenopathy, and hepatic lesions can closely mimic metastatic malignancy on cross-sectional imaging and 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography/computed tomography (FDG PET/CT).

pmc-13620224.title: In-depth exploration of sugammadex and novel neuromuscular blockade antagonists: a narrative review
pmc-13620224.creator: Yingbei Qi, Xuan Xu, Xinmin Wu, Lvhong Luo, Qing Jie, Youmao Qi
pmc-13620224.description: Sugammadex is a modified γ-cyclodextrin widely used in clinical practice to reverse neuromuscular blockade induced by non-depolarizing neuromuscular blockade agents, notably rocuronium and vecuronium. It has been proven to selectively reverse rocuronium-induced neuromuscular blockade within 3 min of administration, representing a revolutionary breakthrough in anesthesiology.
